insurer: THE NEW INDIA ASSURANCE CO. LTD.
sum_insured_options: ₹50,000 – ₹75,000 (implied from schedule references; exact range not stated in wording)

room_rent.note: Room rent capped at ₹450 per day inclusive of nursing/treatment charges for general ward. ICU charges also capped at fixed amounts per day.

icu.note: ICU charges capped at ₹1,800 per day (all intensive care infrastructure & facilities). Ventilator ₹450/day extra.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording.

sub_limits.note: Extensive schedule of fixed sub-limits for named surgeries (e.g. cataract ₹10,800, hysterectomy ₹22,500, CABG ₹36,000, angioplasty ₹12,000). Modern treatments capped at 10% of SI each. Several conditions capped at 25% or 10% of SI.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases excluded for 36 months from policy inception. No optional reduction mentioned.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 90 days for diabetes/hypertension/cardiac; 24 months for cataract, hernia, piles, etc.; 36 months for joint replacement, ARMD, genetic disorders, mental illness.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18. Only ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% increase in SI per claim-free year, maximum 30%. Bonus reduced at same rate if claim made. Option to take premium discount instead.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation medical expenses covered up to 30 days.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered up to 60 days, subject to maximum 10% of hospital bill.

day_care.note: Specific listed day-care procedures covered (e.g. cataract, dialysis, chemotherapy, etc.) as enumerated in the hospitalisation definition.

domiciliary.display: Covered (15% of SI; many diseases excluded)
domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered at 15% of SI. Excludes asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis and several other conditions. Home care treatment (stroke/spine/lower limb injury) covered ₹13,500–₹27,000.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) covered up to 100% of sum insured per policy year.

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered (excluding cost of organ) subject to recipient's sum insured limit.

ambulance.note: Actual expenses or ₹1,000 whichever is less, for emergency transfer to hospital or between hospitals.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments covered (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, etc.) each capped at 10% of SI per policy period.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical consumables (gloves, masks, diapers, etc.) explicitly excluded in Annexure I.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly states all medical expenses/surgery must be taken in India (Clause 5.15). Treatment outside India excluded.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace period for non-monthly premium modes; 15 days for monthly mode. No coverage during grace period.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for new policies of 1 year or more.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, dental (non-accident), external prosthetics/hearing aids, treatment outside India, RFQMR/ECP/EECP/hyperbaric O2, vaccination, circumcision (non-medical), sleep apnea devices

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in the policy document.
